title: Exposed frozen-state BEMR interface-flux mechanism discriminator
scientific_question: On immutable C5R R2048-T16 prescribed-head moving-phase states, with both integrated storage and centered first water-content moment projected exactly to D12_B2P5, does the mathematically qualified BEMR reconstruction reduce internal-interface flux error relative to CURRENT_LAYER_FACE without changing the Reference trajectory or fitting to its residuals?

workload.phase_schedule: Exactly C5R/C5T PHASE1 and PHASE2; HOLD is excluded because BEMR has so far been mathematically qualified only for prescribed-head lower-boundary closure.

retained_representation.storage_state: S_i projected exactly from fine Reference water content.
retained_representation.moment_state: M_i=sum_n (z_n-zc_i)*theta_n*dz_n using fine compartment centers z_n=(n-0.5)*0.078125 cm for every fine compartment inside retained layer i.

new_output: one C6D centered water-content moment per retained layer and observation
one C6D boundary record per observation containing native top flux, native bottom head and bottom mode
identity_requirement: All pre-existing LAREGW1_STATE lines byte-identical to authoritative C5T/C5R trajectory.
All C5T layer-storage and fine-face lines byte-identical.

external_conditions.bottom: positive suction psi_bottom = - native prescribed bottom_head; all evaluated moving points must have bottom_mode=5

bemr_operator.candidate_flux: shared BEMR interface flux after solving the global D12 algebraic profile map; no candidate quantity feeds back into Reference.

numerical_contract.core: unchanged C6C BEMR equations, constitutive interval, 96-point state quadrature and solver tolerances
per_observation_starts: PRIMARY_CONTINUATION: previous qualified primary BEMR solution in the same history; first moving observation uses the affine-dual state start.
INDEPENDENT_AFFINE: affine-dual start reconstructed independently from current S_i and M_i.
numerical_contract.solver: scipy.optimize.least_squares method=trf with C6C xtol=ftol=gtol=1e-12 and max_nfev=8000
numerical_contract.all_points_requirement: Both starts must converge, satisfy C6C hydraulic/state/quadrature gates and agree within the C6C branch-agreement tolerances at every moving observation.

reference_and_baseline_flux.fine_reference: Exact C5T formula using aligned R2048 fine face pair, arithmetic K mean, and fine pressure-head gradient.
reference_and_baseline_flux.current_layer_face: Exact C5T CURRENT_LAYER_FACE formula on projected D12 layer storages.

metrics.all_interface_secondary: same diagnostics over all 11 internal faces and moving phases

BEMR_SUPPORTED_FOR_BOUNDARY_EXTENSION_QU: All 2304 moving-state BEMR solves pass the frozen two-start numerical qualification.
On pooled primary moving metrics, BEMR is componentwise no worse than CURRENT_LAYER_FACE for RMSE, mean-absolute interface/history signed bias, and sign-mismatch count.
BEMR pooled primary moving RMSE is strictly smaller than CURRENT_LAYER_FACE by more than 1e-10 cm/day.
At each of 150, 155 and 157.5 cm, BEMR moving-phase RMSE is no worse than CURRENT_LAYER_FACE within 1e-10 cm/day.
adjudication.BEMR_MIXED_NO_FREE_RUNNING: Some primary metric/interface improves while another preregistered component worsens, with all numerical gates passing.
adjudication.BEMR_NOT_SUPPORTED: BEMR fails numerical qualification or CURRENT_LAYER_FACE is componentwise no worse on the primary moving vector.
adjudication.next_if_supported: Authorize response-free mathematical qualification of BEMR lower prescribed-flux/HOLD boundary semantics before any fresh blind free-running BEMR test.
adjudication.next_if_mixed_or_not_supported: Stop BEMR mechanism route without changing dual order, moment state, Se bounds, starts, tolerances, metric vector or interface set.

stop_rules: No use of HOLD response in C6D adjudication because prescribed-flux BEMR external closure has not yet been qualified.
No change to C6C entropy map, P3 dual space, constitutive interval or solver tolerances.
No new metric or threshold after response.
No Reference, RossFast or groundwater-coupling change.
No application, performance, speed or production-ROM claim.

implementation_binding.binding_note: C6D histories, projected S/M state, BEMR equations, starts, metrics, interface set, repaired logging delegation, execution blobs and workflow are frozen before any authoritative C6D Reference response or operator metric.
